critical_variable: second argument of usb_submit_urb (the gfp_t flag) inside em28xx_init_usb_xfer()
path_conditions: em28xx_init_usb_xfer() is invoked from analog/digital initialization paths in process context (e.g. em28xx-video / em28xx-vbi start_streaming via v4l2 vb2 callbacks and em28xx-dvb start_streaming) and from the dvb start helpers; none of these run in atomic context (no spinlock is held across the call, no IRQ/softirq dispatch). Therefore GFP_ATOMIC is unnecessary and the sleeping-allowed GFP_KERNEL is correct.
rationale: Classic delay-gfp pattern: a memory-allocating helper (usb_submit_urb) is called with GFP_ATOMIC even though the enclosing function only ever runs in process context. The fix swaps GFP_ATOMIC for GFP_KERNEL so the allocator may sleep and the atomic memory reserve is not consumed needlessly.
